༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor bdun bsres bzhugs so/ /de nas phyi 'phred kyi dus sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin du byas la/mchod pa rnams

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor bdun bsres bzhugs so// de nas phyi 'phred kyi dus sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin du byas la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas mdun bskyed gsal gdab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas bsang / oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhar+m+ma swa bhā wa shud+dhohaṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'phros pas ra ba/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol du 'phros pas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba las bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur pa'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ waṃ las chu/ laṃ las sa/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shu yod pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa ba'i stegs bu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la/ lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i me tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i thad so bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang /

rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang par gyur/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ gzhan yang mchod rten brgyad/ chu bo brgyad/ me brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis gang ba/ ro dang ro langs dang / 'dre dang / srin po sha za'i tsha ོgas dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag bzang ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor phrag dgu/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phrag dgu/ de dag gi dbus ma'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ am̐ las gri gug yu ba am̐ gis mtshan pa/ shar du gam̐ las gri gug yu ba gam̐ gis mtshan pa/ lhor tsam̐ las ḍa ma ru rked par tsam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu bam̐ las ru sbal dpral bar bam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du gham̐ las sbrul gyi dpral bar gham̐ gis mtshan pa/ byang shar du pam̐ las seng ge'i dpral bar pam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ shar lhor sham̐ las dge slong gi thugs kar sham̐ gis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu lam̐ las 'khor lo'i lte ba la lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/

nub byang du ḍam̐ las rdo rje'i lte ba la ḍam̐ gyis mtshan pa bsam/ nyi zla phyag mtshan dang bcas pa rnams so so'i gnas su 'dres pa las/ dbus su kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka rgyab zhal bzhi gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dngapo na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na shar bha sngon po dang / brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbur re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbur brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje bsngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'ang pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma/ sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar du gau rī nag mo/ g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/

lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai tā lī ser mo g.yas ru sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu/ g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge/ g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon 'khar bsil 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan pa/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa dang dbyer med par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la aḥs mtshan pa/ dga' ba bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra mahā rā ga su khaṃ da da tsa tur ā nan+da bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kārmaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa tsa tur ā nan+da da ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha si si kun+dhu ru badz+ra dhṛ ka ces pa'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ thig le de yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa las/ gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/

chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang gtso bo yab yum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus gtso bo yab yum la thim/ gau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ semasacan gyi gti mug dang gzugs phung sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang gau rī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus gau rī la thim/ tsau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang tsau rī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus tsau rī la thim/ bai tā lī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes dang bai tā lī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus bai tā lī la thim/ ghasma ri dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang ghasma ri'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus ghasma ri la thim/ puk+ka sī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med dang puk+ka sī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus puk+ka sī la thim/ sha ba rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa dang sha ba rī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sha ba rī la thim/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus tsaṇ+ḍa lī la thim/ g.yung mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms tshad med pa dang g.yung mo'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus g.yung mo la thim/ gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa spros/ ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad sbyangs/ gzhal yas khang pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo rnam par dag par byas te/ bcud kyi sems can lhar gyur pa rnams de'i nang du 'khod/ tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang la thim/

dur khrod brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad rnam par dag par byas/ tshur 'dus dur khrod brgyad la thim/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spros/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar byas/ tshur 'dus bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo kha phye la bgegs mi 'jug pa'i don du rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṃ gor+dha ke sha wartam ne/ tsa tur biṃ sha ti netrāya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā la/ a ne ka dha ri ṇi/ āt+ma tā kru ra tsit+ta ya/ ar+dhen du daṃṣ+ṭī ṇi/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga ran/ ban+dha ban+dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭā kan/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sha truṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥphaṭ swāhā/ zhes pas bgegs bskrad/ sta gon gyi lha la ni ri te nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin zhing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol ba mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog mnyes te/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan zhing / /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/

/he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pas bstod/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wan/ mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wa ra/ gau rī ākar+ṣa ya dzaḥ tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ bai tā li ban+dhā ya baṃ/ ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug slar yang rang gi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs par mos/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ se gol brdab/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥl sogs pas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas/ yang rigs lnga spyan drang bar mos la/ bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra pañja ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ se gol brdab/ ni ri ti nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ sku thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang / gau rī dang puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang sha ba rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā lī dang tsaṇ+ḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ ghasma ri dang ḍoṃ bhi nī la 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ lha so so la dmigs la/ gtso bo la oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes dang / oṃ nam̐ badz+ra nai rāt+ma/ oṃ gam̐ badz+ra gau rī/ oṃ tsam̐ badz+ra tsau rī/ oṃ bam̐ badz+ra bai tā li/ oṃ gham̐ badz+ra ghasma rī/ oṃ pam̐ badz+ra puk+ka sī/ o+oṃ sham̐ badz+ra sha ba rī/ oṃ lam̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ oṃ ḍam̐ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi nī zhes kun la sbyar la/ sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/

zhes pa rang rang gi yi ge brgya pa rdzogs par brjod la byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye la/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa phyi dang / nang dang / yid las byung bas mchod/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bstod pa rgyas pa rnams kyis bstod par bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol ba'i gtor ma btang la bdag 'jug blang ste tshar ba dang gtor ma bsngo ba'o// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 bla ma dam pa/ dkyil 'khor bdun bsres/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
